aboutSection.title: One Ecosystem, Diverse Services, One Goal
aboutSection.description: OBC Group is an enterprise founded on May 7, 1999 in Bandung, West Java. Originating from Onny Barber Center, OBC has consistently expanded and managed various business units to deliver beneficial services and serve diverse community needs. Today, OBC spans multiple sectors, including personal care, sports, hospitality, food & beverage, laundry, agribusiness, and multipurpose spaces.

aboutPage.storyTitle: One Ecosystem, Diverse Services, One Goal
aboutPage.storyText: Recognized widely as a tourism destination in Indonesia during the 1990s, PT Onny Barber Center (OBC) was officially established on May 7, 1999 in Bandung, West Java. Onny Barber Center (OBC) emerged as a service enterprise committed to providing valuable services to society and fulfilling broad public needs. Additionally, PT OBC manages multiple business units, expanding its service scope and business reach.
aboutPage.visionText: OBC serves as a platform to empower families and surrounding communities toward financial independence and growth into high-quality human resources. OBC aspires to become the foremost, trusted, and sustainable integrated service platform in Indonesia, delivering more comfortable, healthy, and meaningful life experiences through diverse business units across hospitality, recreation, sports, culinary, laundry, and agribusiness, while driving economic development by empowering MSMEs, local actors, and Bandung's regional potential.
missions: Delivering prime services that are safe, comfortable, high-quality, and affordable across all OBC Group units.
Building synergy among units as an integrated business network providing convenience, added value, and one-stop service for customers.
Empowering families, surrounding communities, MSMEs, farmers, local entrepreneurs, and communities through market access, partnerships, and continuous promotion.
Developing professional, high-integrity human resources who serve from the heart.
Conducting business with innovation, ethics, sustainability, and social responsibility.
